# Supported agentgateway releases, ascending, one per line: the first line is
# the declared floor, the rest is the rolling window. The acceptance workflow
# and `make testacc-matrix` read this file as the single source of truth.

# v1.7.0 is the latest release, and also the floor: it is the first release

# `frontend.policy` in v1.7.0). Add the next release as a second line.
